_comment: JKSS-FUND student roster (v3.0). Names only — NO student email addresses, ever. The provisioning tool derives a stable, unique username from each name with mobile/src/identity.js (assignUsernames) and maps it to the synthetic Firebase identifier <username>@students.jkss-fund.invalid. Add an explicit "username" to override a derived handle; add "legacyIdentifier" (an existing users/{id} document) ONLY when you have confirmed the match by hand — that is how an ambiguous existing profile is linked without guessing.
